notes: Long bare leaders and a harsh central fork do not form the broad layered crown in the concept.
The new flare is continuous but renders black and ends as two pointed feet rather than grounded roots.
The low bough is identifiable but reads as a straight shelf with no recovering terminal gesture.
Negative space is mostly absence of crown mass, not composed windows inside a coherent canopy.
One right-side neighborhood dominates while most flowering spurs collapse or disappear in projection.
